confidence_notes: I did two web searches. One found the RBA 4.00pm AUD/USD rate for 18 November 2026 (0.6720 USD per AUD). I found it through RBA exchange-rate pages and a site that republishes the RBA rate, but I did not open the RBA page myself. The other search found aggregated 2026 cost-of-living figures for Vilnius. Those sources gave a cappuccino at about EUR 2.5-4.5, a 0.5L draft beer at about EUR 3.8-6.5 (around EUR 5 in the centre) and an inexpensive meal at about EUR 10-12. A three-course dinner in a good restaurant was about EUR 32 per person. The sources disagree with each other and some may be out of date. I converted euros to US dollars at about 1.10 USD per EUR. I got that rate by comparing the RBA's AUD/USD and AUD/EUR figures for the same day, as reported by a site republishing RBA rates. I did not search for cocktail or wine prices. I estimated them from how they usually compare with beer in Baltic cities and from general knowledge, so they are less certain. All accommodation prices are estimates from general knowledge for July 2026, which is peak summer season. I did not look at any booking pages or listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with Riga and Tallinn. These are similar Baltic capitals in the eurozone. Vilnius is generally a little cheaper than Tallinn and about the same as Riga, with Old Town prices higher than in other districts.
